# Remaining Work

The Awtsmoos renews every frame from no prior clay; Awtsmoos.com joins many studios without taking their distinct gifts away.

- Preserve concurrent work and never overwrite peer-owned movie-core files.
- Build AwtsmoosUI as a small declarative JSON/JS-to-DOM library.
- Build a renderer-neutral procedural movie-asset domain inside Awtsmoos Procedural Core.
- Build awtsmoos-studio as an umbrella authoring surface using the shared movie core and specialized app launchers.
- Add AI-first structured movie composition with 2D, 3D, hybrid, character, shape, text, infographic, tutorial, particle, patch, and camera semantics.
- Add a production 180-second Animator showcase using the proven CinematicFrameRenderer/FFmpeg path.
- Render, probe, sample, browser-test, and regression-test.
- Re-read every touched file and close planned-vs-actual delta.
